tricks.trick: Kharif-धान, Rabi-गेहूँ. बरसात में धान; ठंड में गेहूँ. Protein = दाल; Fat = तिलहन.

H-G: Hybridisation (cross) – Gene insert (GM). दो रास्ते better variety के.

tricks.trick: C-HOPKNS CaFe — याद रखो major ones: C,H,O from air/water; NPK + Ca,Mg,S macros; Fe and friends micros.

tricks.concept: खाद – कम्पोस्ट, वर्मीकम्पोस्ट तथा हरी खाद
tricks.trick: C-V-G: Compost pit – Vermi worms – Green manure (मूँग/ग्वार). तीन तरह की organic खाद.
F-fast, M-marathon: Fertilizer = fast yield; Manure = marathon soil health. Organic = reduce chemicals.
Mix = Mixture in field; Inter = Interval rows. Drought → light soil hurt more; check dams help recharge.
